text.id: Setahun kemudian. Bandung, jam dua pagi.
text.en: A year later. Bandung, two in the morning.

text.id: Kamar kos tiga kali empat. Kasur di lantai, rice cooker di pojok, dan laptop yang kipasnya bunyi kayak mau terbang.
text.en: A three-by-four rented room. A mattress on the floor, a rice cooker in the corner, and a laptop whose fan sounds like it's about to take off.

text.id: Kerjaan gue sekarang ngedit audio iklan. Suara orang senyum-senyum jualan asuransi. Gue potong napasnya, gue rapihin "eee"-nya, gue kirim. Lima puluh ribu per menit jadi.
text.en: These days I edit audio for ads. People smiling their way through insurance pitches. I cut their breaths, clean up their "umm"s, send it off. Fifty thousand rupiah per finished minute.

text.id: Kerjaannya rapi. Bosnya puas. Gue nggak pernah inget satu pun isinya.
text.en: The work is clean. The client's happy. I never remember a single word of it.

text.id: Di tab sebelah, kebuka dari tadi sore, ada satu hal yang gue nggak berani tutup.
text.en: In the next tab, open since this afternoon, is the one thing I can't bring myself to close.

text.id: "Suara Pesisir, Episode 11." Diunggah tiga minggu lalu. Empat ratus dua belas kali diputar.
text.en: "Suara Pesisir, Episode 11." Uploaded three weeks ago. Four hundred and twelve plays.

text.id: Pendengarnya udah dua kali lipat. Gue sendiri bingung mesti seneng apa gimana.
text.en: Her listeners have doubled. I don't know how to feel about that.
Close the tab. For real this time.

text.id: Kursor gue udah di tanda silang. Udah setahun kursor gue di situ.{w} Jari gue malah ngeklik tombol putar.
text.en: My cursor is already on the X. It's been there for a year.{w} My finger clicks play instead.

text.id: Halo, pendengar Suara Pesisir. Gue Sekar, dan ini episode sebelas. Malam ini kita ngobrol sama ibu-ibu pengupas kerang di Muara Angke.
text.en: Hi, Suara Pesisir listeners. I'm Sekar, and this is episode eleven. Tonight we're talking with the women who shell mussels in Muara Angke.

text.id: Mereka kerja dari subuh, tangannya penuh luka kecil, dan tiap tahun kerangnya makin sedikit. Kenapa? Nah. Itu yang mau kita cari tahu.
text.en: They work from before dawn, their hands covered in tiny cuts, and every year there are fewer mussels. Why? Well. That's what we're going to find out.

text.id: Audionya bersih. Anginnya nggak bunyi kayak pesawat jatuh.{w} Siapa pun yang ngedit sekarang, dia lebih rajin dari gue.
text.en: The audio is clean. The wind doesn't sound like a plane crash.{w} Whoever edits it now is more careful than I ever was.

text.id: Oh iya. Episode dua belas lagi gue garap. Yang ini... beda. Doain ya.
text.en: Oh, and. I'm working on episode twelve. This one is... different. Wish me luck.

text.id: HP gue bunyi. Jam dua lewat empat belas.{w} Nggak ada yang ngechat gue jam segini. Nggak ada yang ngechat gue, titik.
text.en: My phone buzzes. Fourteen minutes past two.{w} Nobody texts me at this hour. Nobody texts me, period.
